title: Classify medical devices — classifyMedicalDevices
text: Uses ellmer Chat object (e.g., ellmer::chat_google_gemini() ellmer::chat_ollama()) screen classify unique device_name entries: device: Flags whether item truly medical device ("yes" ""), excluding non-device products creams, pharmaceuticals, nutritional feeds. Class: Assigns true medical devices EU/UK MDR risk class (Class , Class IIa, Class IIb, Class III) EU/UK IVDR risk class (IVD (Class ), IVD (Class B), IVD (Class C), IVD (Class D)). Medical speciality: Assigns true medical devices clinical speciality (Anesthesiology, Cardiovascular, Chemistry, Dental, Ear, Nose, Throat (ENT), Gastroenterology Urology, General Plastic Surgery, General Hospital, Hematology, Immunology, Neurology, Obstetrical Gynecological, Ophthalmic, Orthopedic, Pathology, Physical Medicine, Radiology, Toxicology, ). Implantable & active status: Flags whether true medical devices implantable ("yes" "") whether active/powered devices ("yes" ""). Confidence: Reports classification confidence ("high", "medium", "low") every evaluated item support targeted manual review.
